title: Participated preview freshness: the latest own note by feed position wins regardless of the surface that wrote it (shell, injected MCP, host context), or the receipt makes its cut visible
outcome: Participated preview freshness: the latest own note by feed position wins regardless of the surface that wrote it (shell, injected MCP, host context), or the receipt makes its cut visible
acceptance: a regression records two notes on one open item from the same session through two surfaces (shell and MCP) and asserts the participated preview on the next shell next is the newer note by feed position; if the notes carry different actor session ids the receipt says which session the preview reflects

when the host-context block is generated from an older read cut than the live store, the block carries the cut's position and build so staleness is visible; a note recorded after the cut is not silently absent

completion.summary: Delivered participated-preview build/read-cut/generation diagnostics and canonical own-actor note-session/native-position details across CLI and MCP, with unchanged selection and closed review corrections.
